text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"It definitely lives up to its reputation as the trending online chess game.
To think there's an opponent whose moves I can't read this well."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...I see. I wondered what kind of expert it was, but it's a prototype deep learning AI. That explains it."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Her match record is still undefeated...
Heh... How interesting. I'll be the one to hand her a defeat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And by the time Dream Journey claimed victory,
night had already fallen.
